info.name: Knock Audiences Accounts Bulk operations API

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the bulk operation to retrieve.

items.docs: Retrieves a bulk operation (if it exists) and displays the current state of it.

info.name: Bulk update message statuses for channel

params.name: channel_id
params.description: The ID of the channel to update messages for.

params.name: action
params.description: The target status to be applied to the messages.

items.docs: Bulk update the status of messages for a specific channel. The channel is specified by the `channel_id` parameter. The action to perform is specified by the `action` parameter, where the action is a status change action (e.g. `archive`, `unarchive`).

params.name: collection
params.description: The collection this object belongs to.

items.docs: Bulk deletes objects from the specified collection.

params.name: collection
params.description: The collection this object belongs to.

items.docs: Add subscriptions for all objects in a single collection. If a subscription for an object in the collection already exists, it will be updated. This endpoint also handles [inline identifications](/managing-recipients/identifying-recipients#inline-identifying-recipients) for the `recipient` field.

params.name: collection
params.description: The collection this object belongs to.

items.docs: Delete subscriptions for many objects in a single collection type. If a subscription for an object in the collection doesn't exist, it will be skipped.

params.name: collection
params.description: The collection this object belongs to.

items.docs: Bulk sets up to 1,000 objects at a time in the specified collection.

Bulk creates up to 1,000 schedules at a time. This endpoint also handles [inline identifications](/managing-recipients/identifying-recipients#inline-identifying-recipients) for the `actor`, `recipient`, and `tenant` fields.

params.name: tenant_ids[]
params.description: The IDs of the tenants to delete.

items.docs: Delete up to 1,000 tenants at a time in a single operation. This operation cannot be undone.
Set or update up to 1,000 tenants in a single operation.

Bulk sets the preferences for up to 1,000 users at a time. The preference set `:id` can be either `default` or a `tenant.id`. Learn more about [per-tenant preferences](/preferences/tenant-preferences). Note that this is a destructive operation and will replace any existing users' preferences with the preferences sent.
Identifies multiple users in a single operation. Allows creating or updating up to 1,000 users in a single batch with various properties, preferences, and channel data.
Permanently deletes up to 1,000 users at a time.
